requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: Requirement is unambiguous. The original text 'Generate a dial tone' is a high-level functional instruction. The controlled context (CST-01) provides the specific technical implementation details (350 Hz and 440 Hz) but does not mandate them as part of the requirement statement itself; they remain as supporting context. The requirement is structured as a single functional requirement with the action 'generate' and object 'dial tone'. The interaction pattern is autonomous_system_activity as the system initiates the generation.

structured_requirements.final_statement: The system shall generate a dial tone.
structuring_notes: Original text preserved as the functional statement. Technical specifications (350 Hz/440 Hz) from controlled context are not forced into the final statement unless explicitly required by the requirement text, preserving the original scope.

unsupported_inferences_avoided: Did not assume specific frequency values (350 Hz/440 Hz) into the requirement statement as they are provided as context constraints, not as part of the core functional predicate in the original text.
